data.name: Reemsha
data.long_meaning: The name Reemsha is derived from the Arabic word 'Reem' which means 'dew' and 'Sha' which means 'night'. So, Reemsha means 'Night Dew'. This name is often given to girls born during the rainy season as a symbol of beauty and grace.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reemsha is a spiritual name that symbolizes the blessings of Allah (SWT) in the form of night dew. It reminds us of the blessings we receive in our lives, no matter how small they may seem.
data.numerology_meaning: Reemsha is a name that vibrates with the energies of the number 1. It signifies new beginnings, leadership, and independence. People with the name Reemsha are natural born leaders and innovators.
